commands.test: docker compose exec -T backend pytest -p no:cacheprovider && (cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit)
commands.deploy_prod: ssh linode 'cd /root/clio && git pull --ff-only && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build backend celery && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml restart frontend'

deploy_note: The deploy MUST restart the frontend LAST. Recreating the backend container gives it a new IP; the frontend nginx caches the old upstream and 502s every /api call until the frontend is restarted.
